exposure: mode of delivery (elective vs emergency caesarean section)
cohort: Pregnant women attending Obstetrics and gynecology department in Kamla Raja Hospital Gwalior
finding: Emergency caesarean delivery was associated with significantly higher fetal complications than elective caesarean sections.
mod_finding: The rate of transient tachypnea of the newborn was not significantly different between babies born by elective and emergency caesarean section, but hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy was significantly more common in babies born by emergency caesarean section.
